snippet.title: CODE EXIT | Official Demo Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing CODE EXIT, a co-op horror game for 1-4 players.

We are thrilled to announce the release of the first demo build for CODE EXIT.

We invite you to experience the tension firsthand and would greatly appreciate your interest and support.

Demo available from Tue, 19th May 2026 18:00 pm PT @
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2511300/CODE_EXIT/
- Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/code-exit-16c7ba

This demo serves as the first impression of the co-op horror we want to build: a space seized by AI, a closing pursuer, and teammates who must rely on each other amidst limited information. We hope users directly experience the tension, the laughter, and the intense catharsis of a narrow escape when all these elements click together.

Beyond the demo, we expect CODE EXIT to leave players not just with memories of fear, but with a lasting impression of their own choices and the collective moments shared with their team.
